parameters.name: AssetsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: AssetsInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the asset. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: AssetsType
parameters.description: The type of the asset for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all asset types are queried.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port for an exact match. The value must be an integer from 1 to 65535. If you leave this parameter empty, all ports are queried.

parameters.name: PublicIp
parameters.description: The public IP address for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all public IP addresses are queried.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description: The risk level. If you leave this parameter empty, all risk levels are queried.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the application for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all applications are queried.

parameters.name: ServiceNameFuzzy
parameters.description: The name of the application for a fuzzy match. If you leave this parameter empty, all applications are queried.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the access request.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
